description: Config for THIS repo only (the sites' shared preset is default.json). Run by Mend's hosted Renovate app, which works on public repos. Keeps the runner (renovatebot/github-action) and smoke.yml's actions current, and — load-bearing — each automerged bump is a commit, which keeps this PUBLIC repo active so GitHub doesn't auto-disable the scheduled renovate.yml after 60 days of no activity.

packageRules.description: Minor/patch action bumps: automerge. No PR checks exist in this repo, so ignoreTests is required or Renovate waits forever. Majors stay as PRs for a human look.
